profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at CoStar Group
profile.summary: I'm a Senior Software Engineer with over 15 years of experience building enterprise software in various industries including e-commerce, warehouse management, real estate, and finance. I have a degree in Computer Science from Ateneo de Manila University. Currently based in Orange County, California.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software development for services processing Happy Money loans and loan applications, mainly in Java and the Spring Boot Framework.

•	Developed Java Spring Boot microservices to integrate the Happy Money loan funnel with Plaid, allowing applicants to securely and conveniently link bank account information using a vendor technology platform. Using MongoDB for storage.
•	Developed microservices to improve automation of loan application verification using third party APIs, refactoring functionality out from a Clojure-based monolithic solution. This reduced the effort and costs for manual review, and made services more scalable. Using DynamoDB for storage.
•	Developed service to manage the syncing of data between a Salesforce solution and a relational database (Postgres), refactoring legacy code and scripts into efficient modern APIs

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software development for order processing in an e-commerce solution, mainly in C# and the .NET Framework.

•	Developed scalable backend services managing post-checkout activity and customer service transactions for orders on an e-commerce store, handling over 100,000 orders per day, mainly in C# and the .NET Framework
•	Designed and implemented services managing orders and customer data with Microsoft SQL Server and MongoDB
•	Refactored legacy backend WCF services into scalable, containerized RESTful WebAPI microservices
•	Developed services for processing refunds, reships, and facilitating reverse logistics, replacing a manual process with an automated customer-driven flow, reducing customer service workload
•	Developed a service for the calculation and processing of orders with US sales tax.
•	As technical lead of a team of up to 7 developers, mentored junior developers while working with stakeholders to balance business needs with technical requirements.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development and maintenance of Toro irrigation management and home automation software.

•	Development on the Turf Guard soil monitoring system, written in Java and running on both locally managed Linux servers and Amazon RDS MySQL databases.
•	Development on an enterprise-level irrigation management and outdoor lighting web application. Technologies include C#, the ASP.NET MVC framework, RESTful web services, and the Windows Azure cloud computing platform.
•	Development on a WPF desktop application for the configuration of residential and commercial irrigation controllers.

positions.title: Technology Consultant
positions.description:
Development, implementation, and support of Warehouse Management System solutions for a Fortune 100 consumer goods company.

•	Implemented system architecture for a Linux-based warehouse management system – centered on the Java-based RedPrairie software suite and Oracle RDBMS – replacing a legacy WMS system for a Fortune 100 company.
•	Working in an ITIL framework, fulfilled systems administration needs of a C++ and Linux-based warehouse management system. Handled system incidents, implemented changes, and resolved problems on Unix/Linux servers at over 100 client locations worldwide as client locations grew 30%.
•	Headed the startup of a service management team to support the application and infrastructure for a newly developed warehouse management solution.
•	On-site implementation and support of WMS system launches in the United States and Europe.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Development of software and test utilities for the device components of NCR SelfServ Checkout, a self-service Point of Sale system.

•	Developed and maintained a C++-based suite of software that allows for the automatic detection, firmware management, and utilization of system components for a self-service checkout system.
•	Developed a C++-based application for the automated testing of self-service checkout system components to verify compliance with industry standards.
•	Developed a utility to record and compare information on various files across a range of versions of a software suite.
•	Conducted training on advanced C++, Java, and Windows programming topics for internal employee development and for university teaching staff.
